description: Dunhallow Roost, Hollow's End, its staff, and the neutral-ground network.

entries.title: Dunhallow Roost
entries.summary: A precarious sky settlement supports travelers, local society, and adventure amid recent disruptions and concealed faction interests.
body: Dunhallow Roost is presented through its population, social character, recent events, notable residents, and immediate adventure hooks. Its public life centers on travel and survival, while private arrangements connect it to wider powers.
The settlement's best-known establishment is [[hollows-end-tavern|Hollow's End Tavern]], whose friendliness masks a carefully maintained neutral-ground compact.

entries.title: Hollow's End Tavern
entries.summary: A welcoming tavern in Dunhallow serves as an information exchange, refuge, and covertly enforced neutral meeting place.
body: Hollow's End offers food, drink, lodging, familiar patrons, and a steady flow of travelers. Its staff cultivate an atmosphere in which rivals can meet without immediately drawing steel.
That safety is deliberate. [[killain-red-omara|Killain O'Mara]] and [[zara-hollows-end|Zara]] uphold a pact backed by interests far larger than the tavern itself.

entries.title: Killain Red O'Mara
entries.summary: The tavernkeeper of Hollow's End is a former sea and sky sailor with a brief criminal past and a binding commitment to neutrality.
body: Killain's years aboard ships taught him how crews, rogues, merchants, and officers behave when trapped together. A short life among criminals left useful contacts and a strong understanding of consequences.
On returning to Dunhallow, he helped establish Hollow's End as a place where hospitality and restraint are enforced through reputation, preparation, and the neutral-ground pact.

entries.title: Zara of Hollow's End
entries.summary: Hollow's End's waitress presents a carefully constructed past while serving Draconic intelligence and protecting the neutral-ground agreement.
body: Zara's public history is an illusion designed to make her appear ordinary and rooted in Dunhallow. In truth, she is connected to Draconic Empire intelligence and monitors the tavern's visitors and agreements.
Her role is not merely espionage. She ensures that the strategic neutral space remains functional, interprets threats, and can invoke authority symbolized by the mark above the door.

entries.title: Neutral Ground Network
entries.summary: Marked establishments provide strategically useful spaces where hostile factions can negotiate under a shared prohibition against violence.
body: The Ouroboros entwined with a ship's wheel identifies recognized neutral ground. The symbol promises shelter for negotiation but also warns that powerful interests will punish those who violate the compact.

Neutral locations serve merchants, pirates, imperial agents, mercenaries, and local leaders who need exchanges impossible in openly controlled territory. The tradition traces itself to [[daeron-ironheart-veld|Captain Daeron Ironheart Veld]].
